tweetText: The AI boom is creating a divide between those who benefit and those who don't, even within tech. This growing inequality could shape the future of innovation and access. via TechCrunch AI
ArXiv will ban authors for a year if they rely entirely on AI to produce their research papers. This move aims to ensure the integrity and quality of scientific work. via TechCrunch AI

OpenAI co-founder Greg Brockman is now leading product strategy as the company aims to merge ChatGPT with its coding tool, Codex. This move could enhance AI capabilities, making them more versatile and user-friendly. via TechCrunch AI

Some asexuals are turning to AI companions for emotional intimacy without sex, sparking mixed feelings in the community. This highlights the evolving nature of relationships and how technology impacts personal connections. via WIRED AI.

Sony is clarifying its AI Camera Assistant after backlash over a demo that didn't impress. It claims the tool offers suggestions for photo adjustments, but many find its performance lacking. via The Verge AI
